overview: Orillia had 33,411 residents in 2021, up 7.2% from 31,166 in 2016, in 14,422 occupied private dwellings on just 28.53 square kilometres. The median age is 46.8 and the median household income in 2020 was $71,000, so the customer base is older and more budget-conscious than in many nearby growth towns.

Steady public-sector employers such as the hospital and the provincial police headquarters support a stable local economy. Businesses that earn trust and offer clear value tend to keep customers here for years.
